name: card
title: Card
description: A bordered, rounded content surface with header / title / description / action / content / footer parts. The surface, radius and border come from `Box`; the card owns only its column layout, its padding and its shadow.
author: ofri-peretz <https://github.com/ofri-peretz>

## @interlace/card

Installed to `components/ui/card.tsx`.

```tsx
import { /* … */ } from '@/components/ui/card';
```

Props, a11y contract, live preview and source: https://ds.interlace.tools/c/card

Requires the `@interlace/theme` CSS baseline (installed automatically as a registry dependency).
